name: akamai-blog-200x200
description: Replicates the request shape in Akamai's published RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell benchmark: 200 input tokens, 200 output tokens, concurrency 1, 100, 200. Concurrency 100 and 200 will saturate a 20 GB GPU with an 8B FP16 model; the sweep is kept so the saturation point is visible.
